title: Troubleshoot a Cribl Routing or Persistent Queue Issue
objectives: Troubleshoot a Cribl Routing or Persistent Queue Issue
Verify real recorded events, retained failures and current operational evidence.

tasks.instruction: Open Recorded integration operations → Cribl routing. The fixture retains three actual pending records and failed receipts for a fictional unavailable HEC destination. Inspect the pending critical-1, critical-2 and debug-1 source records; the queue is a persisted teaching buffer, separate from full native Cribl persistent-queue files.

Configure native route fields so severity === 'debug' goes to devnull with final=true, then a final=true catch-all sends the remaining events to splunk_out. Use pipeline=passthru. Only true/false and a single quoted scalar ===/!== predicate are supported; arbitrary JavaScript is rejected. Preserve the supplied virtual HEC token and set the separate fictional destination available=true. Stage sources, activate routes and poll.

Verify that debug-1 alone is dropped, both critical records have actual event IDs, and pending=0. Retry without duplicates. Search index=routed_logs | stats count and inspect the job: count=2. Independently verify severity=debug returns zero events and both operational severities remain searchable.

hints: Inspect running source and actual receipts before changing configuration.
Use the paused fixture clock deliberately; verify results through a separate view or query.

references.purpose: Native filter, output and final semantics; bounded predicate execution

checks.label: Actual retained delivery, pending and failure evidence

feedback.success: Verified operational state and retained evidence meet the lesson outcomes.
feedback.incomplete: Inspect actual source, activation, receipts and independent evidence.
